results.prompt: a pulse extender: a button press keeps a lamp lit for at least 3 seconds
results.finalLine: DONE. `design.rsd.json` passed validation on the second round, and all 7 tests pass in the simulator. The stone button's 1 s (10-tick) pulse is split into four repeater delay lines, delayed by about 1, 9, 18 and 27 ticks. Their outputs join on one dust line into the lamp, so it stays lit from the press for about 3.7 s (37 ticks). The tests confirm it is lit at ticks 3 through 31 and off by tick 70. The only warning left is W108 (the repeater orientation hasn't been confirmed in game yet), which the docs say is safe to ignore while authoring. Ports and tests were not changed.
